## Wave 2 Summary

Wave 2 is the NCG / spectral-triple registry-refinement wave. Four COMPUTE-class gates, all numerical-threshold, owned by the spectral-functional / NCG-axiomatic axis. They resolve four distinct refinements of the substrate's spectral-triple structure on `(A_K, H_K, D_K)`:

- **Item 8 (`S103-NNU-BUNDLE-EXHAUSTIVENESS`)** — extends the borrowed-`H` shift-covariance rank test to a SECOND candidate scale `w2 = m_H` (or EW VEV). The augmented power matrix `P = [p_MKK | p_w2]` over all emergent dimensional-scale observables (5 dagger-rows + the Higgs/EW-VEV row) is rank-tested by SVD. PASS (rank 1) confirms the §VII.BS clause-(b) bundle-exhaustiveness premise (Open Q6); FAIL (rank ≥ 2 with a `w2`-touching decorrelated pair) re-scopes the §VII.BS headline.
- **Item 9 (`S103-S7-LC-TIER1-REANCHOR`)** — promotes §VII.BT to registry-PASS eligibility (STAGE-3 pathway) by pre-registering a DIMENSIONLESS Level-3 (the `peel_heldout` truncation invariant) AND running the Stage-2 cross-axis two-reviewer PASS-AND per `joint-theorem-promotion.md`. Honors the Tier-1/Tier-2 dimensional-re-anchorability gate.
- **Item 10 (`S103-VIIAM-LINDEXED-ANCHOR`)** — re-derives the §VII.AM envelope-row Level-3 anchor as L_max-INDEXED (`anchor(L)` from the per-L effacement deviation `δΓ_eff/Γ_eff`) and re-evaluates Registry-PASS at the empirical α = 4.6905. The indexing RULE is pre-registered BEFORE evaluation (anti-comparator-shopping).
- **Item 11 (`S103-FOREIGN-STACK-B1B2`)** — extends the foreign-stack bit-exact re-implementation (monoculture-remedy reproducibility) from the (1,1) Peter-Weyl block to the bottom-of-spectrum (0,0) and (0,1) blocks; eigenvalue extraction via `H = iD` `eigvalsh` ONLY (the W3-12 methodology pin).

Carry-forward source: S102 W1/W2/W3 WP CF blocks + the S102 review campaign (2026-06-10). All four are present in a WP CF block (items 8/9/10/11 = context items 8/9/10/11; item 11 dual-ID = CF-S103-W3-1).

## Wave 2 Decision Point Prerequisites

No HARD cross-wave run-order edge gates any Wave 2 item (per `session-103-partition.md §"Run-order edges"`). Two soft couplings, neither blocking:

- **Item 8 ↔ W1 item 6** (`§VII.BS clause-(b) SCOPE-ANNOTATION patch`): both touch §VII.BS from DIFFERENT layers — item 8 is the COMPUTE that tests the bundle-exhaustiveness premise; W1 item 6 is the ANNOTATION that scopes clause-(b) regardless of the test outcome. The annotation lands independent of item 8's verdict; on item-8 PASS the annotation upgrades from "standing premise" to "result". No dispatch edge — item 8 reads ONLY `s102_nnu_falsifier_ii_rank1_covariance.npz` + the s84 cache + canonical constants, all already on disk.
- **Item 9 Stage-2** consumes the §VII.BT Stage-1-CANDIDATE registry text (already landed S102 W2-3, registry :21415) + the `s101_w3_lc_pole_cert.npz` certificate (S101 W1-2 PASS, on disk). Both prerequisites are present; the gate is dispatchable.

If any input file is absent at dispatch, the gate honestly closes per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (PRE-REG-INC). All four input npz files were verified present on disk at plan-freeze (2026-06-10).

```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "set"            # rank(Cov_aug) is an integer set-membership outcome {1} vs {>=2}
  form: "rank(Cov_aug) = |{ sigma_i : sigma_i / sigma_max > rank_threshold }| ; PASS iff == 1"

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "N/A — closed-form SVD on a (n_obs x 2) augmented power matrix"
  L_max: "12 — m_H map uses the s84 L12 cache spectral content; rank test is L-independent (outer-product structure)"
  scan_range: "N/A — single augmented-matrix SVD, no scan"

  scheme: "log-Jacobian-outer-product-covariance"

  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic (SVD of a fixed real matrix)"

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain  — m_H -> M_KK-power column (sign/power claim: MANDATORY chain)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "m_H carries M_KK-power +2 under single-w renormalization (a_4-dressed |S|^2 mode),
            so its power column is NOT independent of the dagger-row generator -> rank stays 1."

    Definition 1: m_H = the framework Higgs mass = the KK-threshold correction to the |S|^2
                  transverse-fiber mode (m_H_FW_KK_threshold = 131.8 GeV; canonical_constants).
                  [canonical_constants.py: m_H_FW_KK_threshold = 131.8; src KK-THRESHOLD-64 / S28c]
    Definition 2: in the spectral action S_b = Tr f(D^2/Lambda^2) ~ f_4 Lambda^4 a_0 + f_2 Lambda^2 a_2 + f_0 a_4,
                  the Higgs quartic + mass terms reside in the a_4^{ζ} moment (a_4^{ζ} = 1350.7216,
                  Yang-Mills + Higgs-quartic). The Higgs mass-squared scale m_H^2 ~ f_0 a_4^{ζ} / (f_2 a_2-Higgs-kinetic)
                  with Lambda = M_KK. [Chamseddine-Connes-Marcolli 2007; regulator a_n^{ζ}]
    Definition 3: borrowed-H single-w renormalization assigns each emergent dimensional observable O_i a
                  power p_i of the SINGLE cutoff w = M_KK: O_i = w^{p_i} * Ô_i, Ô_i dimensionless
                  (registry §VII.BS O = w·Ô factorization). [registry §VII.BS clause (c)]

    Substitute:   m_H = [f_0 a_4^{ζ} / (f_2 a_2)]^{1/2} * M_KK ; the dimensionful prefactor's M_KK content
                  is set by Lambda = M_KK in S_b. Write m_H = M_KK^{p_w2} * (dimensionless Higgs-sector ratio).
    Simplify:     a_4 enters at Lambda^0 (f_0 a_4), a_2 at Lambda^2 (f_2 Lambda^2 a_2). The Higgs mass-squared
                  m_H^2 = (f_0 a_4)/(f_2 a_2) carries Lambda^{0-2} = Lambda^{-2} from the moment grading,
                  BUT the canonical KK-threshold normalization fixes m_H ∝ M_KK^{+1} at the |S|^2 mode

                  ⇒ p_w2(m_H) = +1 in the SAME generator as M0_from_mH (dagger-row 4, p = +1).
    Canonical form: p_w2 column = c · (M_KK-power generator); the column is a SCALAR MULTIPLE of the
                  existing dagger-row generator (no new independent direction).
    Direction:    scalar-multiple column ⇒ Cov_aug remains a rank-1 outer product ⇒ rank(Cov_aug) = 1.
    Conclusion:   m_H (and v_ew, which carries the same M_KK power by the EW-VEV = a_2-Higgs-kinetic^{1/2}
                  scaling) do NOT decorrelate from the dagger-row bundle ⇒ bundle exhaustive ⇒ clause-(b)
                  premise CONFIRMED. The FAIL branch (rank >= 2) is reached ONLY if the m_H map produces a
                  power column NOT expressible as a scalar multiple of the M_KK generator (an independent
                  second physical scale), which the substitution chain shows it is not under single-w renorm.
                  [NOTE: the chain PREDICTS rank 1; the gate TESTS it — the SVD is the arbiter, not the chain.]
```
